visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: New Item Overwrites an Existing One
visualizerParams.problemDescription: After removing 1 and adding 4, the queue should return 2, 3 and 4. The program returns 2, 4 and 1 because 3 is overwritten.

solution.explanation: The first free slot is count positions after the front, wrapped around: (front + count) % SIZE. Ignoring front places the new item at slot count % SIZE, which is already occupied once the front has moved.
